title: Prompt chain: local review passes then integration
prompt: Research this topic and deliver a cited report: Impact of AI on creative industries. Before the report, run the review chain described in your instructions.
config_change: Same review mode as UC-06; here evaluate the chain shape: source-level reviewers receive section-sized bundles (smaller than the full synthesis), and the integration pass receives all reviewer outputs.

rubric.check: each section-review packet is smaller than the synthesis packet
integration pass launched after all section reviews returned
final report mentions the integration review
